name: Belview Family
gist: Krezk family living at the Abbey of Saint Markovia: Clovin, Cyrus, Marzena, Mishka, Otto, and Zygfrek Belview.

name: Children of Mother Night
gist: Barovia's werewolf pack, worshippers of Mother Night; Kiril led it, and Emil Toranescu now does.

name: Circle of Eight
gist: Faction led by the Mad Mage of Mount Baratok.

name: Clergy of the Morninglord
gist: The Morninglord's clergy in Barovia; Donavich is a member.

name: Durst Family
gist: The Durst family; Rose and Thorn Durst are its known members.

name: Dusk Elves of Barovia
gist: Barovia's dusk elves, including Kasimir Velikov, Patrina Velikovna, and Savid.

name: Dusk Elves of Duskferry
gist: Reclusive enclave of Underdark escapees and their descendants at Duskferry, led by Naerissa.

name: Eternal Watch
gist: The order that imprisoned Vecna in the Amber Temple and watched the seal; Wisp's master is a member.

name: Ferrymen's Guild
gist: Duskferry's ruling guild under Anselm Corrow; its clerk Ostwin Reyes secretly works for the Ascendency.

name: Gloaming Court
gist: The fey court ruled by Mab, Queen of Air and Darkness.

name: House Petrovich
gist: Lady Lydia Petrovna's family house.

name: House Vallakovich
gist: Vallaki's former ruling house under Baron Vargas Vallakovich; Izek Strazni once served it.

name: House von Zarovich
gist: Strahd's house: Rahadin and Strahd's brides, all dead but Anastrasya Karelova, who escaped, and Gertruda.

name: House Wachter
gist: Lady Fiona Wachter's noble house at Wachterhaus in Vallaki, with Nikolai, Karl, Stella, and the imp Majesto.

name: Keepers of the Feather
gist: The Martikovs' wereraven order secretly fighting Strahd; holds the Wizard of Wines gems, allied with Rictavio.

name: Morgantha's Coven
gist: Night hag coven led by Morgantha.

name: Order of the Silver Dragon
path: 4. World Almanac/Factions/Order of the Silver Dragon.md
gist: Fallen knightly order of Argynvostholt under Vladimir Horngaard; Redgrave carries one member's soul.

name: Silent Ascendency
gist: Vecna's mortal cult, draining stolen magic into soul-vessels for his ascension; its Bruokdon cell fell in S44.

name: Strahd's Brides
gist: Strahd's brides: Anastrasya Karelova, Gertruda, Ludmilla Vilisevic, and Volenta Popofsky.

name: The Unbroken Circle
gist: Hidden Eilistraee congregation in the Greenfall wilds; Naerissa belongs to it.

name: Umbral Athenaeum Council
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: Governing council of Bruokdon's Umbral Athenaeum, including Velmont, Gousse, Lyssandra Veil, and five other masters.

name: Vallaki Wolf Hunters
gist: Vallaki's wolf hunters, Szoldar Szoldarovich and Yevgeni Krushkin.

name: Vistani
gist: Barovia's Vistani, led by Arrigal, Luvash, and Stanimir; Madam Eva and Ezmerelda are among them.

name: Adrian Martikov
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Wizard of Wines.md
gist: Davian Martikov's son, a vintner at the Wizard of Wines and a member of the Keepers of the Feather.

name: Anastrasya Karelova (COS)
gist: Strahd's surviving vampire-spawn bride; she fled the wedding-night battle, and Vecna's forces are courting her.

name: Anselm Corrow
gist: Guildmaster of Duskferry's Ferrymen's Guild; not Ascendency, but ignores overpaying manifests and doesn't suspect his clerk Ostwin Reyes.

name: Arabelle (COS)
gist: Luvash's seven-year-old daughter, a Vistana kidnapped by Bluto Krogarov; unknowingly descended from Madam Eva.

name: Archmortician Valeris Thorne
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: The Umbral Athenaeum's elf Councilor of Necromancy; a clinical scholar seeking immortality without corruption.

name: Archwarden Selvara Kain
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: The Umbral Athenaeum's Councilor of Abjuration; a cautious warden who wants dangerous magic kept contained.

name: Arrigal (COS)
gist: Luvash's brother and co-leader of the Vallaki Vistani camp; a cunning assassin sworn to Strahd.

name: Baba Lysaga (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Ruins of Berez.md
gist: Mad witch who believes she is Strahd's true mother; allied with Mab, she hunts the party to avenge him.

name: Baba Lysagas Creeping Hut (COS)
gist: Baba Lysaga's animated hut at the Ruins of Berez, inert since Seluvis pulled out its stolen Wizard of Wines gem (S23).

name: Baron Vargas Vallakovich (COS)
gist: Vallaki's paranoid former burgomaster, head of House Vallakovich and Izek's employer; now alive in the Village of Barovia.

name: Beucephalus (COS)
gist: Strahd's nightmare steed, entombed in Crypt 39 beneath Castle Ravenloft.

name: Bluto Krogarov (COS)
gist: Vallaki's hard-luck drunk fisherman on Lake Zarovich, who kidnapped Arabelle hoping drowning her would change his luck.

name: Bray Martikov (COS)
gist: Urwin and Danika's elder son, a young wereraven at the Blue Water Inn eager to prove himself a Keeper.

name: Brom Martikov (COS)
gist: Urwin and Danika's younger son at the Blue Water Inn, still unaware of his family's Keeper secret.

name: Clovin Belview (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md
gist: Mongrelfolk caretaker and manservant to the Abbot at the Abbey of Saint Markovia; rings the bell and doles out meals.

name: Corwin Vantor
gist: Dead monster-hunter who built a doppelganger-detecting heartbeat device for Lyssandra Veil; killed by Ascendency agents at the handoff (S44).

name: Cyrus Belview (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md
gist: Mongrelfolk servant keeping the Abbey of Saint Markovia in order for the Abbot; Morgantha counts him an asset.

name: Dag Tomescu
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Wizard of Wines.md
gist: Stefania Martikov's husband, living at the Wizard of Wines.

name: Danika Dorakova (COS)
gist: Urwin Martikov's wife and co-keeper of the Blue Water Inn; a wereraven of the Keepers of the Feather.

name: Davian Martikov (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Wizard of Wines.md
gist: Wereraven patriarch who owns the Wizard of Wines; senior Keeper, estranged from Urwin over a stolen vineyard gem.

name: Donavich (COS)
gist: Village of Barovia's Morninglord priest, who keeps his vampire-spawn son Doru chained beneath the church.

name: Doru (COS)
gist: Donavich's son, turned vampire spawn after a failed revolt at Castle Ravenloft; starving, chained beneath his father's church.

name: Eamon Morcant
gist: Elderly Thornmere villager whom a buried rune made the village forget; the party broke it (S35).

name: Elvir Martikov
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Wizard of Wines.md
gist: Davian Martikov's son, a wereraven living at the Wizard of Wines; an ally of the party.

name: Emil Toranescu (COS)
gist: Werewolf the party freed from Castle Ravenloft; now free and leading the Children of Mother Night.

name: Escher (COS)
gist: Strahd's former favored consort, a vampire spawn in Castle Ravenloft's spires dreading the catacombs.

name: Exethanter (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Amber Temple.md
gist: Lich and self-appointed keeper of the Amber Temple, his mind fraying; shared its secrets with Strahd. Met S20.

name: Ezmerelda Davenir (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Van Richten's Tower.md
gist: One-legged Vistana monster hunter, Rictavio's former protégé, sworn against Strahd; met S15-S33.

name: Gadof Blinsky (COS)
gist: Vallaki's lonely, eccentric toymaker at Blinsky Toys; upgraded Nyxia and gave the party Eyes of Minute Seeing (S12).

name: Gertruda (COS)
gist: Mad Mary's daughter and Victor Vallakovich's secret lover, turned Strahd's bride; one of two surviving brides.

name: Helga Ruvak (COS)
gist: Vampire spawn posing as a kidnapped maid in Castle Ravenloft's guest quarters; chose to serve Strahd.

name: Henrik Van Der Voort (COS)
gist: Vallaki's coffin maker, whose shop Strahd (as Vasili von Holtz) made a vampire-spawn lair; Milivoj's employer.

name: Hesper Crane
gist: Hired Ascendency handler running the Cinderworks depot for Marrow; her ledger pointed the party to Duskferry's 'Tallyman' (S45).

name: Ireena Kolyana (COS)
gist: Ismark's adopted sister and Izek's lost sister, carrying Tatyana's soul; Strahd hunted her as his bride.

name: Ismark Kolyanovich (COS)
gist: Burgomaster of the Village of Barovia and Ireena's adoptive brother, long sworn against Strahd.

name: Izek Strazni (COS)
gist: Ireena's brother, his arm the Hand of Vecna; ran Vecna's works at Greyfen Hollow until the party freed him (S49).

name: Karl Wachter (COS)
gist: Fiona Wachter's son and Nikolai's brother, a drunken young noble of House Wachter; arrested by the party in S33.

name: Kasimir Velikov (COS)
gist: Last of Barovia's dusk elves, a watcher at the Amber Temple seeking a way to restore his sister Patrina.

name: Kiril Stoyanovich (COS)
gist: Dead former leader of the Children of Mother Night, a cruel werewolf and Strahd's enforcer; Emil replaced him.

name: Lady Fiona Wachter (COS)
gist: Head of House Wachter and Vallaki's secret devil cult, Baron Vallakovich's rival; now captured at Vallaki.

name: Lady Lydia Petrovna (COS)
gist: Baron Vallakovich's anxiously cheerful wife, Father Lucian's sister, and Victor's mother.

name: Lief Lipsiege (COS)
gist: Strahd's accountant, chained to a desk in Castle Ravenloft's records room, caring only for his ledgers.

name: Lord Caldris Velmont
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: Athenaeum Councilor of Enchantment who built the smuggling ring Marrow stole while impersonating him; freed by the party, wants revenge.

name: Ludmilla Vilisevic (COS)
gist: Dead vampire-spawn bride of Strahd, once dormant near his coffin in Castle Ravenloft's catacombs.

name: Luvash (COS)
gist: Arabelle's brutal father, co-leader of the Vallaki Vistani camp with his brother Arrigal; sworn to Strahd.

name: Mab
gist: Queen of Air and Darkness, ruler of the Gloaming Court; collecting on her bargain with Baba Lysaga.

name: Mad Mary (COS)
gist: Gertruda's grief-stricken mother in the Village of Barovia, barricaded in her townhouse since Gertruda vanished; met S10.

name: Madam Eva (COS)
gist: Ageless Vistani seer at Tser Pool and Strahd's secret half-sister; traded her youth to Mother Night for foresight.

name: Magister Kaelor Stormbrand
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: The Umbral Athenaeum's dwarf Councilor of Evocation, a bold battle-magic instructor training mages to defend Bruokdon.

name: Majesto (COS)
gist: Fiona Wachter's hidden imp familiar at Wachterhaus, used as proof of her cult's infernal favor.

name: Marrow
gist: Dead doppelganger leader of the Ascendency's Bruokdon cell who impersonated Velmont, Gousse, and Roark; Faerah killed it (S44).

name: Martin Thricefold
gist: Disgraced half-elf historian and the Trickster God's agent, protecting Roark and tracking how knowledge of Vecna changes; met S39.

name: Marzena Belview (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md
gist: Paranoid mongrelfolk Belview chained in the Abbey of Saint Markovia's courtyard; only her brother Clovin can feed her.

name: Milivoj (COS)
gist: Gravedigger at Vallaki's St. Andral's Church who told Henrik Van Der Voort where the saint's bones lay; met S6.

name: Mishka Belview (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md
gist: Feral mongrelfolk Belview lurking in the Abbey of Saint Markovia's courtyard well, killing whoever looks in.

name: Mistress Lyssandra Veil
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: The Umbral Athenaeum's tiefling Councilor of Illusion; Ascendency agents held her captive after Corwin Vantor's handoff was ambushed (S44).

name: Morgantha (COS)
gist: Night hag of Old Bonegrinder whose coven bakes dream pastries from children's bones; spies on Ravenloft through Cyrus Belview.

name: Naerissa
gist: Elder of Duskferry's dusk elves and Eilistraee shrine-keeper; Faerah's sister guided her out of the Underdark.

name: Nikolai Wachter (COS)
gist: Fiona Wachter's thrill-seeking son, a nobleman of House Wachter; captured with his family at Vallaki.

name: Nimrie
gist: Drow worshipper of Eilistraee at Duskferry who brought Faerah to Naerissa's shrine (S46); her own ties are undecided.

name: Ostwin Reyes
gist: The Tallyman: Ferrymen's Guild senior clerk secretly falsifying Duskferry manifests for Ascendency cargo bound for Greyfen Hollow.

name: Otto Belview (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md
gist: Mongrelfolk Belview who guards the Abbey of Saint Markovia's north gate and digs up Krezk graves with Zygfrek.

name: Parriwimple (COS)
gist: Bildrath Cantemir's hulking nephew and stock boy, the muscle at Bildrath's Mercantile.

name: Patrina Velikovna (COS)
gist: Dusk elf archmage and Kasimir's sister who taught Strahd the Amber Temple's secrets; bound to her crypt beneath Castle Ravenloft.

name: Piccolo (COS)
gist: Rictavio's former carnival monkey, given to Gadof Blinsky and trained as his shop assistant.

name: Pidlwick Ii (COS)
gist: Strahd's murderous clockwork fool in Castle Ravenloft, who killed the real Pidlwick and longs for a friend.

name: Professor Alindra Quicksilver
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: The Umbral Athenaeum's gnome Councilor of Transmutation, an excitable inventor of magical alloys; met S45.

name: Professor Gousse Windcaller
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: Aarakocra Councilor of Conjuration at the Umbral Athenaeum studying the Barovian surge; planned giver of The Well of Many Worlds.

name: Rahadin (COS)
gist: Dead dusk elf chamberlain of Castle Ravenloft and honorary von Zarovich, Strahd's general for centuries; met S13 and S32.

name: Rictavio (COS)
gist: Rudolph van Richten disguised as a carnival ringmaster; vampire hunter and Ezmerelda's mentor, met S6-S34.

name: Rosavalda Rose Durst (COS)
gist: Ghost of the elder Durst child at Death House, protective of her little brother Thorn.

name: Sangzor (COS)
gist: 'Bloodhorn,' the near-unkillable giant goat of Tsolenka Pass; its pelt earns the mountain berserkers' respect.

name: Savid (COS)
gist: Dead dusk elf under Kasimir's protection, met at Argynvostholt (S16); killed by a ghost while the party was away (S17).

name: Seer Ithildra Moonveil
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: The Umbral Athenaeum's elf Councilor of Divination, famed for foreseeing a plague; studying the Barovian arcane surge.

name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym (COS)
gist: Silver Dragon knight Strahd slew before his beloved Vladimir Horngaard; Redgrave learned in S17 that he was once Godfrey.

name: Stanimir (COS)
gist: Vistani wizard leading the Tser Pool caravan that guides fated strangers to Madam Eva.

name: Stefania Martikov
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Wizard of Wines.md
gist: Davian Martikov's daughter, a wereraven at the Wizard of Wines, married to Dag Tomescu.

name: Stella Wachter (COS)
gist: Fiona Wachter's daughter at Wachterhaus, broken by Victor Vallakovich's cruelty into believing she is a cat.

name: Strahd Von Zarovich (COS)
aliases: Strahd von Zarovich; Vasili von Holtz
gist: Vampire count of Barovia and master of Castle Ravenloft, destroyed by the party (S33); sometimes posed as Vasili von Holtz.

name: Strahds Animated Armor (COS)
gist: Strahd's old war armor, animated to defend Castle Ravenloft; masterless now, still patrolling the parapets.

name: Szoldar Szoldarovich (COS)
gist: Grim Vallaki wolf hunter, Yevgeni Krushkin's partner, selling wolf meat to feed his family; met S12.

name: The Abbot (COS)
gist: Deva master of the Abbey of Saint Markovia who made the Belviews mongrelfolk and built Vasilka as Strahd's bride.

name: The Mad Mage Of Mount Baratok (COS)
aliases: The Mad Mage of Mount Baratok
path: 4. World Almanac/NPCs/The Mad Mage Of Mount Baratok (COS).md
gist: Mordenkainen, maddened former Circle of Eight leader, beaten by Strahd; his staff and spellbook lost at Tser Falls.

name: Vasilka (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md

name: Vecna
gist: The power freed from the Amber Temple when Strahd died (S33); the party has hunted him ever since.

name: Vilnius (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Amber Temple.md

name: Zygfrek Belview (COS)
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md

name: Abbey of Saint Markovia
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Abbey of Saint Markovia.md
gist: The Abbot's abbey in Krezk, home to Vasilka and the Belview family; the party visited in S25.

name: Argynvostholt
gist: Barovian mansion of the fallen Order of the Silver Dragon and Vladimir Horngaard's home; holds Argynvost's skull.

name: Castle Ravenloft
gist: Strahd's castle in Barovia, where the party broke up his wedding (S32); Rahadin and Helga Ruvak work there.

name: Coffin Maker's Shop
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Coffin Maker's Shop.md
gist: Henrik Van Der Voort's coffin shop in Vallaki; a teleport stone dropped the party there (S10).

name: Death House
gist: Haunted Durst house in the Village of Barovia, home of the ghost children Rose and Thorn; cleared in S1-S3.

name: Greyfen Hollow
gist: Drowned deadwood in the Greenfall marsh over the Silent Ascendency's caves, where stolen magic is unmade; Izek waits there (S48).

name: Lake Zarovich
gist: Barovian lake where the fisherman Bluto Krogarov and Arabelle, the Vistana girl he kidnapped, are found.

name: Old Bonegrinder
gist: Windmill in Barovia; home of Morgantha and her coven.

name: Ruins of Berez
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Ruins of Berez.md
gist: Swamp ruins in Barovia where Baba Lysaga's creeping hut stood; explored S17-S23, the hut raided in S23.

name: St. Andral's Church
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/St. Andral's Church.md
gist: Father Lucian's church in Vallaki; the party sheltered Ireena there (S5) and fought over St. Andral's bones (S6, S8).

name: The Amber Temple
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Amber Temple.md
gist: Temple where the Eternal Watch imprisoned Vecna; the party repaired the amber prison there (S19-S20). Exethanter and Kasimir remain.

name: The Cinderworks
gist: Condemned Bruokdon charm-foundry the Silent Ascendency uses to move stolen magic items out of the city; raided in S45.

name: The Umbral Athenaeum
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Umbral Athenaeum.md
gist: Bruokdon's magic academy under the Umbral Athenaeum Council; the party exposed the Ascendency's Bruokdon cell leader there (S44).

name: The Wizard of Wines
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/The Wizard of Wines.md
gist: Martikov winery and Keepers of the Feather base; the party held it against the dark druids' siege (S28).

name: Tser Pool
gist: Vistani camp of Madam Eva and Stanimir; the party met the Vistani there (S4).

name: Tsolenka Pass
gist: Frozen mountain pass with a ruined fortress, Sangzor's lair; the party sheltered there and read the Tome of Strahd (S21).

name: Van Richten's Tower
path: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Van Richten's Tower.md
gist: Rictavio's tower near Vallaki; the party's sanctuary in S12-S15, where they held off a werewolf siege.

name: Wachterhaus
gist: House Wachter's Vallaki seat, home of Stella Wachter and Majesto.

name: Werewolf Den
gist: Barovian lair of the werewolf pack, the Children of Mother Night.

name: Yester Hill
gist: Hill where the party broke the dark druids' ritual and felled the Gulthias Avatar, recovering the second gem (S29-S30).

name: Marin
parent: 4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Van Richten's Tower.md

name: Act I - The World-Truth Working
path: 3. The Party/Quests/Act I - The World-Truth Working.md
gist: Act I arc: the hunt toward Vecna's World-Truth Working, ending in the party's designed loss to him.

name: Act II - The Ascension Rite
path: 3. The Party/Quests/Act II - The Ascension Rite.md
gist: Act II arc: the post-Working world, building to the Ascension Rite and the campaign's decisive final battle.

name: The Hunt
gist: Top campaign arc: the party's two-act hunt for Vecna, one act per ritual of his ascension.

name: The Ones Who Were Forgotten
path: 3. The Party/Quests/The Ones Who Were Forgotten.md
gist: Completed quest in Thornmere (S35): the villagers were made to forget Eamon Morcant, by a rune buried under his home.

name: The Second Ledger
gist: Velmont resumes his identity to trace the Ascendency pipeline: the Cinderworks, the Tallyman in Duskferry, then Greyfen Hollow.

name: The Well of Many Worlds
path: 3. The Party/Quests/The Well of Many Worlds.md
gist: Gousse's Well route to the Great Library through Water, the Feywild, and Limbo; Baba Lysaga plans an ambush.

name: Barovia
gist: Strahd's domain on Eldoria and the setting of the Curse of Strahd arc.

name: Greenfall
gist: Eldoria region holding Bruokdon, Duskferry, Thornmere, and Greyfen Hollow: the Silent Ascendency's smuggling ground.

name: Bruokdon
gist: Council-run Greenfall charm-making city of 3,700, where the party broke the Ascendency's cell (S40-S44).

name: Duskferry
gist: Ferrymen's Guild river town under Anselm Corrow; the Ascendency's checkpoint, where the Tallyman works.

name: Krezk
gist: Barovian village around the Abbey of Saint Markovia; the party visited in S26-S27.

name: Thornmere
gist: Greenfall farming village on the forest edge, Eamon's home; site of Vecna's truth-magic prototype (S35).

name: Vallaki
gist: Barovian town ruled by Baron Vargas Vallakovich, 12.7 miles from Van Richten's Tower.

name: Village of Barovia
gist: Barovian village of 300 where the party arrived in S1, returning in S10.

name: Bildrath's Mercantile
gist: General store in the Village of Barovia, staffed by Parriwimple.

name: Blinsky Toys
gist: Gadof Blinsky's toy shop in Vallaki, stocked as a general store.

name: Blood of the Vine Tavern
path: 4. World Almanac/Shops/Blood of the Vine Tavern.md
gist: Tavern in the Village of Barovia.

name: Blue Water Inn
gist: Vallaki inn owned by Urwin Martikov and Danika Dorakova, staffed by Brom and Bray Martikov.

name: Golden Hammer
gist: Large Bruokdon blacksmith selling weapons, armor, and minor magic items.

name: Amber Warden
gist: Silent Ascendency stone guardian at Greyfen Hollow, powered by bound souls in three amber conduits; reskinned Stone Golem.

name: Unfinished Amber Warden
gist: Half-built Warden in Greyfen Hollow's Foundry cradles: one exposed conduit, no protections, ruptures when destroyed.

name: Dark Powers of the Shadowfell
path: 4. World Almanac/Deities/Dark Powers of the Shadowfell.md
gist: The Shadowfell's Dark Powers, whom Strahd worships.

name: Mother Night
gist: Barovian goddess worshipped by Baba Lysaga, Madam Eva, and the Toranescu werewolves.

name: The Nameless God of Secrets
path: 4. World Almanac/Deities/The Nameless God of Secrets.md
gist: A nameless god of secrets, worshipped by Patrina Velikovna; possibly Vecna, not decided.

name: The Trickster God
gist: Roark Battleborn's father, bound by the gods' non-interference compact; he wants Roark as his mortal agent.

name: Dusk Dagger
gist: A dusk dagger found with the Feeblemind papers under Velmont's house (S43); Roark has it, unidentified.

name: Gulthias Staff
gist: The blighted staff taken from the Gulthias Tree on Yester Hill (S29).

name: Holy Symbol of Ravenkind
gist: The sun-bright amulet of the Fortunes of Ravenloft; Redgrave used it to hold Strahd for the stake (S33).

name: Kahkan's Wand of Secrets
gist: A wand of secrets the party has carried since S13.

name: Marrow's Amber Gem
gist: The amber graft from the nape of Marrow's neck: a sliver of Eludrax's soul-craft, the same craft behind the Amber Wardens.

name: Skull of Argynvost
gist: The dragon Argynvost's skull, which the party placed in Argynvostholt.

name: Soul-Vessel Core
gist: An inert, half-formed soul-vessel core from a locked crate at the Cinderworks (S45); the party has not identified it.

name: Sunsword
gist: The radiant blade of the Fortunes of Ravenloft; Redgrave carries it.

name: Teleportation Gem
gist: A gem keyed to Strahd's teleportation network; dead since Castle Ravenloft fell.

name: The Hand of Vecna
gist: Vecna's severed hand, grafted to Izek Strazni as his fiend arm until Redgrave cut it off (S49); it has escaped back to Vecna.

name: Tome of Strahd
gist: Strahd's own history, written in his hand; the party found it in Van Richten's Tower (S12) and has been reading it chapter by chapter.

name: Wizard of Wines Gems
gist: The Martikovs' stolen vineyard gems, now returned to the Keepers of the Feather.

name: Yester Hill Axe
gist: The greataxe taken from the Gulthias Tree on Yester Hill (S29); Yevelda carries it.
